cover_letter:
Dear Ms Reichelt Trinanes,

I am applying for the Digital Communication Manager role in the Portable Air Division. Your posting says you would rather hear from people who do not tick every box than not hear from them at all, so let me be direct about what I bring.

My work sits where digital strategy meets execution. At Episto I run on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, track the results in Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console, and manage those sites end to end in WordPress. Before that, as Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts, I designed and built client websites from site structure through to content, and supported SharePoint digital workplace platforms for ŞOK Market — more than 4,000 stores with ERP/POS integration — and Aras Kargo's application gallery for 12,000 staff. That work is why a roadmap spanning several brands, markets and internal audiences is the part of this role that interests me most, rather than the part that worries me.

On mirook.com I took a site from nothing to a measurably better search-health score: JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, an llms.txt file and repeated technical audits. I optimise for AI-driven search alongside classic SEO, and I use LLMs and Python daily to automate research, auditing and reporting. For a division that owns its own digital roadmap, that is leverage rather than overhead.

Where I am lighter is equally plain: I have not yet led two direct reports, and I hold coursework in Applied Computer Science rather than a completed degree. What I offer instead is someone who builds the digital work himself, understands the funnel from technical SEO through to conversion, and lives fifteen minutes from your Antwerp offices.

I would welcome the chance to talk it through.

Kind regards,

Baver Ok
